My CEO Day routine for Q4… YIKES it’s Q4 🙃 Now typically I like to do this routine outside of my office to change up my environment, but I haven’t been feeling well so I just kept things at my desk this time. 

As always, I try to organize my P&L report and other KPIs *before* the day starts so I’m not wasting time on admin/accounting and can just focus on the BIG picture of where my business is heading. I also make sure to schedule a fun way to celebrate once I’m finished (usually takes me no more than 2 hours so I’ll take off the rest of the day)! 

I have this whole day in the form of a Notion template that you can grab for yourself for FREE! It’s in my link in bio, just find my free Notion template library sign up and you’ll have access to this and a bunch of other free templates! 

#cozydesksetup #aestheticdesk #resetroutine #founderlife #creativesmallbusiness

My CEO Day routine for Q4… YIKES it’s Q4 🙃 Now typically I like to do this routine outside of my office to change up my environment, but I haven’t been feeling well so I just kept things at my desk this time. 

As always, I try to organize my P&L report and other KPIs *before* the day starts so I’m not wasting time on admin/accounting and can just focus on the BIG picture of where my business is heading. I also make sure to schedule a fun way to celebrate once I’m finished (usually takes me no more than 2 hours so I’ll take off the rest of the day)! 

I have this whole day in the form of a Notion template that you can grab for yourself for FREE! It’s in my link in bio, just find my free Notion template library sign up and you’ll have access to this and a bunch of other free templates! 

#cozydesksetup #aestheticdesk #resetroutine #founderlife #creativesmallbusiness
